description: Extend the existing material-consequences authority with persistent, score-neutral mailbox and Kitchen-window destruction plus a dev-only reset profile

replacements.new:
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-BOARDS-HARDWARE-KNOWN <>>

<GLOBAL MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 0>
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-MAILBOX-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN <>>
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-WINDOW-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-WINDOW-FLAG-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
<GLOBAL MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-DEV-MODE <>>

<OBJECT FIELD-STONE
    (IN WEST-OF-HOUSE)
    (SYNONYM ROCK STONE)
    (ADJECTIVE LOOSE FIELD FIST SIZED)
    (DESC "loose field stone")
    (LDESC "A fist-sized loose stone rests in the grass.")
    (FLAGS TAKEBIT WEAPONBIT)
    (SIZE 6)>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? (OBJ)
    <COND (<EQUAL? .OBJ ,FIELD-STONE ,AXE ,SWORD ,SHOVEL ,WRENCH ,SCEPTRE ,TRIDENT>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DAMAGE-PRESENT? ()
    <COND (<OR <G? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 0> ,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-REMEMBER-MAILBOX-STATE ()
    <COND (<0? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE>
           <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <FSET? ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-REMEMBER-WINDOW-STATE ()
    <COND (<NOT ,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN>
           <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <FSET? ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>>
           <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-FLAG-BEFORE-DAMAGE ,KITCHEN-WINDOW-FLAG>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-RESET-DAMAGE ()
    <COND (,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <FSET ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>)
          (T <FCLEAR ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>)>
    <FCLEAR ,MAILBOX ,TAKEBIT>
    <FSET ,MAILBOX ,TRYTAKEBIT>
    <MOVE ,MAILBOX ,WEST-OF-HOUSE>
    <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 0>
    <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
    <COND (,MATERIAL-WINDOW-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <FSET ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>)
          (T <FCLEAR ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>)>
    <SETG KITCHEN-WINDOW-FLAG ,MATERIAL-WINDOW-FLAG-BEFORE-DAMAGE>
    <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN <>>
    <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-OPEN-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
    <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-FLAG-BEFORE-DAMAGE <>>
    <MOVE ,FIELD-STONE ,WEST-OF-HOUSE>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-RESET-DAMAGE ()
    <COND (<NOT ,MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-DEV-MODE>
           <TELL "Environmental damage reset is available only in the Release 1246 dev/test build. Production breakage remains part of this playthrough." CR>)
          (<NOT <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-PRESENT?>>
           <TELL "No authored environmental breakage currently needs a developer reset." CR>)
          (T
           <MATERIAL-RESET-DAMAGE>
           <TELL "Developer reset restored the authored environmental breakages without changing score, treasures, relationship history, or canonical puzzle progress." CR>)>
    <SETG CLOCK-WAIT T>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-COMPLETION-PROMPT ()
    <COND (<AND ,MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-DEV-MODE <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-PRESENT?>>
           <TELL "|Dev/test world damage remains. Reset environmental breakages before ending this completed run? (Y is affirmative): ">
           <COND (<YES?>
                  <MATERIAL-RESET-DAMAGE>
                  <TELL "Developer reset complete. The next test run starts from an undamaged authored environment." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Leaving the current breakage state in this completed dev session only." CR>)>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DAMAGE-MAILBOX (TOOL THROWN?)
    <MATERIAL-REMEMBER-MAILBOX-STATE>
    <COND (<AND <EQUAL? .TOOL ,AXE> <NOT .THROWN?>>
           <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 3>
           <FSET ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>
           <FSET ,MAILBOX ,TAKEBIT>
           <FCLEAR ,MAILBOX ,TRYTAKEBIT>
           <TELL "The bloody axe bites through the wooden post with a brutal crack. The mailbox tips into the grass, still a usable container but no longer attached to anything the former owners would recognize as landscaping." CR>)
          (<OR <EQUAL? .TOOL ,SWORD>
               <AND .THROWN? <EQUAL? .TOOL ,AXE>>>
           <COND (<L? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 2> <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 2>)>
           <FSET ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>
           <TELL "Metal shrieks against metal. The mailbox door twists out of square and will no longer stay shut; the mail inside survives the architectural criticism." CR>)
          (<0? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE>
           <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 1>
           <TELL "The impact caves a broad dent into the side of the mailbox. It remains anchored, functional, and considerably less picturesque." CR>)
          (<1? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE>
           <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 2>
           <FSET ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>
           <TELL "A second hard impact folds the mailbox door sideways. It still holds mail, but closing it is now a historical concept." CR>)
          (T
           <TELL "The already-mangled mailbox absorbs another insult with a metallic bang. There is very little dignity left to remove." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-BREAK-WINDOW (TOOL)
    <COND (,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN
           <TELL "There is no intact Kitchen pane left to break." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <MATERIAL-REMEMBER-WINDOW-STATE>
    <SETG MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN T>
    <SETG KITCHEN-WINDOW-FLAG T>
    <FSET ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>
    <TELL "The " D .TOOL " punches through the Kitchen window. Glass snaps inward and outward, leaving a jagged but fully passable opening where the pane used to be. The canonical House route is damaged, not blocked." CR>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-THROW-THROUGH-WINDOW (OBJ)
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,EAST-OF-HOUSE>
           <MOVE .OBJ ,KITCHEN>
           <TELL "The " D .OBJ " continues through the opening and lands in the Kitchen." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN>
           <MOVE .OBJ ,EAST-OF-HOUSE>
           <TELL "The " D .OBJ " sails outside and lands behind the House." CR>)
          (T
           <MOVE .OBJ ,HERE>
           <TELL "The " D .OBJ " drops on the far side of the broken glass." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-THROW-DESTRUCTION-HOOK ()
    <COND (<NOT <VERB? THROW>> <RFALSE>)
          (<NOT ,PRSI> <RFALSE>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,MAILBOX>
           <COND (<MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSO>
                  <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-MAILBOX ,PRSO T>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The " D ,PRSO " strikes the mailbox without enough authority to change its shape." CR>)>
           <MOVE ,PRSO ,HERE>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,KITCHEN-WINDOW>
           <COND (,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN
                  <TELL "With the pane already gone, nothing remains to stop the throw." CR>
                  <MATERIAL-THROW-THROUGH-WINDOW ,PRSO>)
                 (<MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSO>
                  <MATERIAL-BREAK-WINDOW ,PRSO>
                  <MATERIAL-THROW-THROUGH-WINDOW ,PRSO>)
                 (T
                  <MOVE ,PRSO ,HERE>
                  <TELL "The " D ,PRSO " taps the intact window and falls harmlessly away." CR>)>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DIRECT-DESTRUCTION-HOOK ()
    <COND (<AND <OR <VERB? MUNG CUT ATTACK>
                   <AND <VERB? KICK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>
           <COND (<VERB? KICK>
                  <MATERIAL-REMEMBER-MAILBOX-STATE>
                  <COND (<0? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE> <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 1>)>
                  <TELL "You kick the mailbox hard enough to dent it and immediately receive a detailed report from your foot about the relative hardness of sheet metal." CR>)
                 (<AND ,PRSI <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>
                  <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-MAILBOX ,PRSI <>> )
                 (T <RFALSE>)>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <VERB? MUNG CUT ATTACK>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-WINDOW>
                ,PRSI
                <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>
           <MATERIAL-BREAK-WINDOW ,PRSI>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DAMAGE-STATE-HOOK ()
    <COND (<AND <VERB? EXAMINE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX> <G? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 0>>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 1>
                  <TELL "The small mailbox is still anchored, but one side is deeply dented." CR>)
                 (<EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 2>
                  <TELL "The small mailbox is battered and its twisted door hangs open. It remains usable as a container." CR>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The small mailbox has been cut free from its severed post. Its body is battered, its door is warped, and it can now be carried." CR>)>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <VERB? CLOSE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX> <G? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 1>>
           <TELL "The warped mailbox door no longer stays closed. That consequence is cosmetic to the journey and very real to the mailbox." CR>
           <FSET ,MAILBOX ,OPENBIT>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <VERB? TAKE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX> <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 3>>
           <COND (<IN? ,MAILBOX ,WINNER>
                  <TELL "You are already carrying the former fixture." CR>)
                 (T
                  <MOVE ,MAILBOX ,WINNER>
                  <TELL "You pick up the mailbox. Severing the post has converted landscaping into luggage." CR>)>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <VERB? EXAMINE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-WINDOW> ,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN>
           <TELL "The Kitchen window has been shattered out. Jagged remnants frame an opening large enough for the same House entry the intact window once provided." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <VERB? OPEN CLOSE> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-WINDOW> ,MATERIAL-WINDOW-BROKEN>
           <TELL "There is no meaningful pane left to "
           <COND (<VERB? OPEN> <TELL "open">) (T <TELL "close">)>
           <TELL ". The broken opening is already passable." CR>
           <FSET ,KITCHEN-WINDOW ,OPENBIT>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DESTRUCTION-HOOK ()
    <COND (<MATERIAL-THROW-DESTRUCTION-HOOK> <RTRUE>)
          (<MATERIAL-DIRECT-DESTRUCTION-HOOK> <RTRUE>)
          (<MATERIAL-DAMAGE-STATE-HOOK> <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-TOOL-CLEAN? (OBJ)
